scope: Hex improvements 1 through 5; CPU search, no neural retraining
policy_selection: Highest balanced completed-game score in development-policy. Ties retain rave_ts, then declared policy order.
optional_feature_adoption: Require at least 5 percentage points candidate score above 50 percent in the declared paired development comparison and pair-bootstrap lower bound above 50 percent. Otherwise retain corrected default and stop the candidate.
host_sharding: Keep both colour-balanced legs of a pair on the same host. Local and Kaggle records remain separately labelled.
stop_rule: No further tuning of candidates that fail the predefined development adoption criterion. Algorithm correctness fixes are mandatory and not rolled back based on playing strength.
external_opponents: Historical Davis and HexHex screenshots are preserved; no claim that new internal games reproduce those opponents.
time_confirmation: Choose and freeze the final policy before running a separate same-host time-budget check. No selection using final outcomes.
